metadata.title: Brute Force Followed By Success - Sentinel Scheduled Rule
metadata.description: Detects 10+ failed sign-ins for a single account within 15 minutes, followed by a successful sign-in. MITRE ATT&CK T1110.
Name of the Log Analytics workspace hosting Microsoft Sentinel
Resource ID of the auto-disable-compromised-user-playbook Logic App

properties.displayName: Brute force sign-ins followed by successful authentication
properties.description: Flags accounts with 10+ failed sign-ins within 15 minutes followed by a success, indicating a likely successful credential-stuffing or brute-force attack.
properties.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
| summarize FailedCount = countif(ResultType != "0"), SuccessCount = countif(ResultType == "0"), LastSuccess = maxif(TimeGenerated, ResultType == "0") by UserPrincipalName, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where FailedCount >= 10 and SuccessCount >= 1
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, FailedCount, SuccessCount, LastSuccess

properties.displayName: Auto-trigger containment playbook on brute-force incident
